title: Chapters 20–22 (Insurance, Investments, Statistics)
instructions: Answer all questions. For short‑answer and fill‑in‑the‑blank, use only one word, letter, or number.

questions.prompt: The person who receives the death benefit from a life insurance policy is the:
questions.feedbackIfWrong: The beneficiary receives the death benefit.

questions.feedbackIfWrong: Straight life (ordinary life) is permanent and builds cash value.
